author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
A new group of explorers is about to chart its course among the stars when Starfield lands on PlayStation 5 on April 7. Starfield feels right at home on the PlayStation 5, with the console’s hardware helping every moment feel smooth and responsive as you explore the Settled Systems. 

Learn more at https://bethesda.net/en/game/starfield/article/1yZpSD4e9tVKNlQoQKCNIs/starfield-playstation-5-exclusive-features
